name: hearth
description: Hearth — an Alexa+ caregiving co-pilot built as a self-hosted MCP server (spec 2025-11-25, Streamable HTTP).

scripts.probe: npm run build -w mcp-http-probe && node packages/mcp-http-probe/dist/cli.js http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p server && tsc -p simulator && tsc -p packages/mcp-http-probe --noEmit
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w mcp-http-probe
